# SobinPay

> Cambodia's Enterprise Multi-Provider Payment Gateway SDK for ABA PayWay and Bakong KHQR. Engineered by Sobin Digital.

SobinPay is the official enterprise TypeScript payment gateway monorepo for Cambodia. It provides a unified, strictly-typed, timing-safe API for processing transactions through Advanced Bank of Asia (ABA) PayWay and the National Bank of Cambodia (NBC) Bakong KHQR EMVCo specification.

## Core Packages

- `@sobindigital/pay`: High-level umbrella gateway client.
- `@sobindigital/provider-payway`: ABA PayWay v2.0 client (Web Checkout Popup/Hosted, Direct KHQR Deeplinks, Check Transaction, RSA Refunds, HMAC-SHA512 Webhooks).
- `@sobindigital/provider-khqr`: National Bank of Cambodia Bakong KHQR (Individual QR, Merchant QR, EMVCo 29-tag parser, CRC-16 CCITT validator).
- `@sobindigital/core`: Zero-loss BigInt Money arithmetic and timing-safe cryptographic utilities (`crypto.timingSafeEqual`).

## Key Highlights & Enterprise Standards

- **Zero-Loss Money**: Uses integer cents (`BigInt`) to eliminate IEEE-754 floating-point rounding errors across USD and KHR.
- **Timing-Attack Resistance**: Uses constant-time `crypto.timingSafeEqual` for all HMAC-SHA512 webhook signature validations.
- **Dual ESM / CJS**: Native ESM (`import`) and CommonJS (`require`) with full TypeScript declarations (`.d.ts` and `.d.cts`).
- **Zero External Dependencies**: Pure Node.js built-ins (`node:crypto`, `node:https`), tree-shakeable, runs on Node >= 18, Cloudflare Workers, Next.js, and Bun.
- **MIT Licensed & Maintained by Sobin Digital**: Production-ready open-source infrastructure with active LTS support.

## Installation

```bash
# High-level all-in-one SDK (Recommended)
npm install @sobindigital/pay

# Or modular provider packages
npm install @sobindigital/provider-payway
npm install @sobindigital/provider-khqr
```

## Quickstart: ABA PayWay Web Checkout

```typescript
import { PayWayClient } from "@sobindigital/provider-payway";

const payway = new PayWayClient({
  merchantId: process.env.ABA_PAYWAY_MERCHANT_ID!,
  apiKey: process.env.ABA_PAYWAY_API_KEY!,
  mode: "sandbox", // or "production"
});

// Create checkout transaction
const checkout = await payway.createTransaction({
  tranId: "INV-2026-001",
  amount: 25.00,
  reqTime: "20261111153000",
  paymentOption: "cards",
  returnUrl: "https://example.com/checkout/callback",
});
```

## Quickstart: Bakong KHQR Generation

```typescript
import { generateMerchantKhqr } from "@sobindigital/provider-khqr";

const khqr = generateMerchantKhqr({
  bakongAccountId: "sobindigital@aba",
  merchantName: "Sobin Digital Store",
  merchantCity: "Phnom Penh",
  acquiringBank: "ABA Bank",
  currency: "USD",
  amount: 15.50,
  billNumber: "INV-8899",
});

console.log(khqr.qr); // EMVCo compliant KHQR string with valid CRC-16
console.log(khqr.md5); // Transaction tracking hash
```

## Quickstart: Timing-Safe Webhook Verification

```typescript
import { verifyPayWayWebhook } from "@sobindigital/provider-payway";

// Secure Next.js App Router Route Handler (POST /api/webhooks/payway)
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const isValid = verifyPayWayWebhook(body, process.env.ABA_PAYWAY_API_KEY!);
  
  if (!isValid) {
    return new Response("Invalid signature", { status: 401 });
  }

  // Idempotently process confirmed payment
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ status: "ok" }), { status: 200 });
}
```
